# Resource: appwrite_auth_team

Manages an Appwrite team.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "appwrite_auth_team" "engineering" {
  name = "engineering"
}

resource "appwrite_auth_team" "marketing" {
  name  = "marketing"
  roles = ["owner", "editor"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The team name.

### Optional

- `id` (String) The team ID.
- `project_id` (String) The Appwrite project ID. Defaults to the provider-level project_id.
- `roles` (List of String) Roles for new team members. Defaults to ["owner"].

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The team creation timestamp in ISO 8601 format.
- `updated_at` (String) The team last update timestamp in ISO 8601 format.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import appwrite_auth_team.engineering <team-id>
```
